messages:
ava: nightly e2e perf gate failed on main — p95 up ~30% vs baseline, job `nightly-e2e-smoke` red. Anyone around to quick triage? :eyes:

raj: looking. can you paste the failing job url? also did we roll any runtime changes in last 24h?

ava: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/45321 — logs attached in CI. Noticed spike at step `e2e/perf/throughput-check` around 00:08 UTC.

morgan: I saw a KV cache tweak PR merged ~3h ago (PR #812). suspecting warmup pattern. pinging @raj

raj: will kick a rerun to confirm flake. running `ci retry nightly-e2e-smoke --build 45321` now.

ci-bot: rerun started: build 45324 (rerun of 45321). ETA ~15m. :gear:

ava: thanks. if rerun fails, can we bisect between `main@~6h` and `main@head`? suspect kernel scheduling change on infra too.

morgan: here's quick diff that might affect KV cache warmup:
```
- cache_size = 256
+ cache_size = 512
```

taylor: if rerun still red, pls collect p95/p99 traces and upload perf flamegraphs to /tmp/ci-perf/45324. I'll do the bisect if needed. assigning @taylor to triage.

ci-bot: rerun finished: build 45324 -> status: FAILED. p95 still +28%.

raj: confirmed. starting bisect to find culprit commits over last 6 hours.

ava: thanks. leave notes here with progress. we should also check node-level metrics (cpu steal, io wait) — I can grab graphs.

morgan: started `git bisect` locally, narrowing to PR #812 vs runtime defaults. posting small diff when I have next.

taylor: noted. if it's PR #812 we can revert and run a targeted warmup test. :thumbsup:

ava: thanks team — appreciate quick responses. will monitor and update.
